Page106's smaller PageMaker image shows three text columns, a picture block, top/left rulers and floating tool palette; fine document copy there is not legible. Page93 shows overlapping Finder windows, practical icons and gray patterned desktop. Page48's rough two-spread column sketches emphasize page planning; page39 reproduces a partially overlapped set of identified newspaper graphics but they are not counted as separate complete works. Page3 contrasts Lucida outline/solid/raster a. These pages establish screen/output distinctions and a readable instructional print grid; no complete-book reading, exact app timing or extra artwork count is claimed. This record is an additional inspected page/version of the same publication and contributes zero additional unique works.

Page10 of the same scan has plain monospaced typewriter-like instruction paragraphs, wide margins, bottom page2 and visible paper show-through. Package and instruction page are one document/artifact family; physical wear and the drawn hand remain research-only. observations.observation: The complete two-sided folded brochure combines a black/cream outlined italic serif logo, angular Altsys mark, order-form lines and postal panel on its outside. The inside uses three ruled column zones, rounded screenshot frames, crisp bitmap menus, font lists, glyph grid, large pixel A editor and conventional serif bullet lists. Insets demonstrate distinct screen states but count once for this brochure. It supplies concrete window/palette and readable instructional-grid evidence; the printed finger illustration is not reused. The archive filename/date is a collector attribution; no release chronology is inferred solely from that filename. summary.scope: Purposive1985–90 print/publication and authoring-language study; modern specimens are explicitly modern renderings of named historic type families, Lo-Res revised2001. Seven selected pages of one1986 book count once; Altsys cover/interiors grouped. One sparse Emigre cover and a PC-only PageMaker package excluded. No publication whole-book-reading, live software playback or animation claimed. Strong Emigre/Altsys and English-language concentration; book supplies concrete interface documentation.
